title: For Mamdani, Oct. 7 Anniversary Sets Off Anger and Bitterness
summary: Hours after some Jewish leaders denounced Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s remarks about the attacks on Israel, activists interrupted a vigil to call him a traitor to the Palestinian cause.
